egn.rule: exactly 10 digits after stripping non-digits; first 8 are a valid YYYYMMDD calendar date; no Bulgarian EGN checksum

encryption: authenticated encryption (AES-256-GCM enc:v1: preferred); fail closed if key missing; no plaintext fallback
bank_status_timing: validate first (failure leaves attempt issued); then encrypt; then PATCH/local bank_sent_process2 using shop order_id = local OC order id
